**Proposed mechanism:** VKORC1 (HGNC:12890) —DISRUPTS→ Vitamin K metabolism (REACT:R-HSA-109602); Vitamin K metabolism (REACT:R-HSA-109602) —DECREASES→ Vitamin K epoxide (CHEBI:17037); Vitamin K epoxide (CHEBI:17037) —DECREASES→ Vitamin K (CHEBI:17036); Vitamin K (CHEBI:17036) —LEADS_TO→ Combined deficiency of vitamin K-dependent clotting factors, type 2 (MONDO:0011837); UBIAD1 (HGNC:24211) —DISRUPTS→ Cholesterol metabolism (REACT:R-HSA-143417); Cholesterol metabolism (REACT:R-HSA-143417) —DECREASES→ Cholesterol (CHEBI:16113); Cholesterol (CHEBI:16113) —DISRUPTS→ Lipid transport and metabolism (REACT:R-HSA-143417); Lipid transport and metabolism (REACT:R-HSA-143417) —LEADS_TO→ Schnyder corneal dystrophy (MONDO:0007374). Concurrently, loss-of-function mutations in UBIAD1 disrupt vitamin K2 synthesis and cholesterol homeostasis, impacting lipid metabolism and contributing to Schnyder corneal dystrophy. Both pathways converge on broader lipid and vitamin metabolism, suggesting an integrated mechanistic link.
